answer_4.quote: We recruited 24 participants equally divided between those who self-identify as progressive or conservative... to test the Perspectives API toxicity model... We recruited six additional participants to verify if the model failures for their political perspective are things they could see themselves appropriately posting online.
answer_4.guideline: Participants wrote statements they would personally post online; raters judged whether the statements were valid tests and whether the model incorrectly labeled them as toxic.
